issues: The original code counts all cycles in the functional graph and adds 1 extra operation for each. This overcounts the minimum operations required. A cycle only requires an extra operation to break if it is a "pure cycle" (i.e., no external nodes or tree edges point into it). If a tree edge points into the cycle's connected component, that tree node can be merged with a cycle node to break the cycle "for free", saving 1 operation.
